body.en: Research, Productization, and Marketing share a mission and rules while keeping their operating responsibilities clear.

title.zh: 从促进增长到世界方案

body.en: What changes when the goal is not only local advantage but a solution others can use, reproduce, deploy, and maintain?
body.zh: 当目标不只是局部领先，而是让更多人和组织能够使用、复现、部署和维护，研究会发生什么变化？
